-- GREEN fixture for `forward-only-migration` — the STORAGE-relevant slice (P-ST-04 / P-020). The
-- lint MUST admit this. The SAME column change expressed as the online expand->backfill->contract
-- shape the storage migration runner (P-ST-05) admits: a NULLABLE column add (no blocking lock),
-- a concurrent index build, then a later forward migration backfills + constrains. There is no
-- reverse/rollback step (a rollback would be a NEW forward migration) and no in-place rewrite
-- (STOR-2, §9).
ALTER TABLE principals ADD COLUMN email_v2 TEXT;
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_principals_email_v2 ON principals (email_v2);
UPDATE principals SET email_v2 = email WHERE email_v2 IS NULL;
